newsitem.title: USA: Rexene sees Q4 EPS near Q1/Q2 earnings.
newsitem.headline: Rexene sees Q4 EPS near Q1/Q2 earnings.

text.p: Rexene Corp said Wednesday its fourth quarter earnings should remain at or near first and second quarter levels because of recent higher feedstock costs affecting the industry.

Earnings grew from $0.34 per share in the first quarter to $0.39 per share in the second quarter and $0.45 per share in the third quarter, but the growth is not expected for the fourth quarter, the company said.
The company said product demand and pricing remain good, but natural gas liquids feedstock costs increased dramatically in late November and early December.
"These share increases will have a negative impact on earnings in December and January," the company said in a release. However the company said major projects that
should improve shareholder value are on schedule.
